subject: Gift crate fulfillment: split delivery, on-site assembly options & quote
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@luxepromos.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ops@rapidship.co
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Gift crate quote + assembly options (v2)

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the call this morning. Attached is the updated quote (gift_crate_quote_LuxePromos_v2.pdf) which reflects the changes we discussed: upgraded foam inserts, palletized split shipment, and an on-site assembly crew rate. Two notes:

- Lead time: production + QA is ~10 business days from PO.
- Backorders: if any SKU is delayed we propose split-fill (ship complete crates that are ready, hold items on backorder and ship separately at no additional freight if under 10% of total).

If you want us to arrange assembly at the venue, our standard team can handle up to 200 crates with a single-day setup. For set-up at the host hotel (which reduces day-of load), add the hotel-handling fee shown on page 3.

Attached: gift_crate_quote_LuxePromos_v2.pdf, crate_assembly_instructions_v1.xlsx

Happy to jump on another quick call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Elena Torres

To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Gift crate quote + assembly options (v2)

Forwarding LuxePromos' updated quote. Quick summary / decision items I need from you both before I sign PO:

1) Split delivery: they propose palletized split shipments (some crates to venue, remainder to hotel for assembly). Is hotel assembly acceptable? If yes, which hotel and receiving contact?
2) Backorder policy: they say split-fill with separate freight if >10% — we want to cap our exposure. Acceptable to approve their proposed no-additional-freight if <10%?
3) On-site assembly: cost for venue day-of vs hotel setup. Marissa, do you prefer hotel setup to reduce day-of risk?

Elena, cc'd — we want to confirm PO timeline. If we approve today, can production start 12/16 and complete by 12/30? We need delivery to venue the morning of 01/05/2027 (event on 01/06).

Thanks,
Sergio

On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Forwarding LuxePromos' updated quote. Quick summary / decision items I need from you both before I sign PO:

Thanks for flagging this. My notes after reviewing the quote:

- Hotel assembly preferred: reduces venue congestion and vendor check-in risk. Our preferred hotel is The Meridian (contact: Receiving Manager, Jenna Cho, jenna.cho@themeridian.com, +1 415-222-3344). They have a loading dock and will hold pallets for same-day assembly.
- Backorder tolerance: agree to LuxePromos' proposal but add a hard cap — if more than 8% of SKU units are on backorder we want contingency: either partial credit or overnight split to catch up.
- Timeline: production start on 12/16 is tight but OK if LuxePromos confirms materials are in hand. We need final QA photos 48 hours before shipment.
- RapidShip: ops@rapidship.co (cc'd) can handle a same-day diversion from hotel to venue on 01/05 if necessary; budget ~ $1,200 for last-mile rush per 100 crates.

Assume budget sign-off up to $4,500 for hotel-handling + expedited last-mile (we'll route through events budget vs. ad-hoc). Laura, can you confirm?

Marissa
Senior Events Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Gift crate quote + assembly options (v2) — PO authorization and delivery instructions

Elena / LuxePromos team,

Thanks — we will proceed with the PO under the following agreed terms:

- Production: start 2026-12-16, complete no later than 2026-12-30.
- Delivery split: 60% of crates to The Meridian (hotel) for on-site assembly; 40% palletized direct to Convene Center receiving.
- Backorders: LuxePromos to absorb freight for split-ships if backordered units are <= 8% of total. If >8%, we will negotiate partial credit.
- QA: final QC photos and sample crate sign-off 48 hours before scheduled pallet pickup.
- PO: I'll issue PO# RF-2026-1123 today once you confirm production start date and the total with hotel-handling fee included.

Venue receiving contact for Convene Center: Receiving Dept <receiving@convene-center.com>, Attn: Marla Jennings, phone +1 415-333-2200. Delivery window requested: 01/05/2027 between 08:00-12:00.

RapidShip ops: please standby for potential same-day diversion request on 01/05. Budget allowance for rush services approved up to $1,500 pending final quote.

Elena, please confirm and return a final invoice PDF/Docusign routing and I will route PO to procurement.

Cheers,
Sergio
